notes: Batch D1 - Deep Trace da xac nhan tren Production (pg_indexes) rang uq_checklist_violation_active_fingerprint (unique index theo noi dung: employee_code|criterion_code|occurred_date|occurred_time(5)|location|note, tao tu PHF_CHECKLIST_VIOLATION_SAFETY_1.14.sql) dang chan CA hai nghiep vu doc lap trung noi dung (Giam sat + Truong ca cung ghi 1 nhan vien/tieu chi/ngay, hoac 2 lan loi thuc trung het cac truong), khong chi gui lap ky thuat - xung dot voi nghiep vu moi da chot. saveChecklistViolations() (lib/checklist-violations.js) go ca 2 co che chan theo fingerprint: pre-check SELECT-roi-loc-bo va check trung noi dung TRONG cung 1 batch (CHECKLIST_BATCH_DUPLICATE_BLOCKED) - duplicate_fingerprint van duoc tinh/luu tren moi row (khong doi normalizeCanonical/duplicateFingerprint()) de danh cho nhan 'Cung loi N lan trong ngay' sau nay, chi khong con quyen chan insert/tru diem/gui workflow. Idempotency ky thuat sau sua chi con dua DUY NHAT vao unique index uq_checklist_violation_request_id (khong doi) qua upsert(onConflict:'request_id',ignoreDuplicates:true) - them 1 check ky thuat moi, KHONG theo noi dung: 2 dong trung request_id trong CUNG 1 batch bi chan ro (CHECKLIST_BATCH_REQUEST_ID_COLLISION) vi Postgres ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING khong xu ly duoc truong hop nay trong 1 cau lenh (se ra loi cardinality violation kho hieu neu khong chan som). saveChecklistViolations() tra them savedRows[].isNew (true=vua insert lan nay, false=request_id da ton tai tu truoc - retry idempotent) bang cach giu lai ket qua tra ve cua LAN upsert dau tien (Postgres INSERT...ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING chi tra dong THAT SU moi insert) truoc khi doc lai (readback) de xac nhan toan bo da persist. Sua kem 1 loi idempotency thuc su phat hien trong luc trace: api/data.js va server.js truoc day phat notification VIOLATION_CREATED cho MOI employeeCode trong payload.violations goc (input thô cua client) o moi lan goi saveChecklistViolations thanh cong, ke ca khi toan bo la retry idempotent - da sua ca 2 file de chi lay recipient tu saved.savedRows.filter(isNew===true). History (trg_phf_audit_checklist_violation_create, PHF_CHECKLIST_VIOLATION_CREATE_HISTORY_1.35.9.sql) la AFTER INSERT trigger nen tu nhien khong ban lan 2 khi ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING khong insert - khong can sua. Migration Production (scripts/PHF_CHECKLIST_VIOLATION_DUPLICATE_UNBLOCK_1.42.0.sql + ROLLBACK_...) da chuan bi (drop uq_checklist_violation_active_fingerprint, giu idx_checklist_violation_duplicate_fingerprint non-unique cho audit) nhung CHUA CHAY - preflight Production xac nhan 0 nhom duplicate_fingerprint dang active nen an toan de drop khi duoc phe duyet. Regression: scripts/test-checklist-violation-duplicate-idempotency.js moi (29 checks: retry tuan tu/dong thoi cung request_id, 2 request_id khac nhau trung noi dung van tao 2 record, sang/chieu, huy 1 trong 2 record doc lap, batch trung request_id ky thuat, batch atomic khi co dong invalid, permission tung dong, Di tre retry). Toan bo 16 script checklist (gom file moi) va npm run check da chay lai sach. Khong sua UX-01, khong sua nghiep vu Di tre, khong doi header X-PHF-Build cu, chua push, chua deploy, chua chay SQL Production.
